name: ballerinax/nats
description: NATS is a cloud-native, open-source messaging system that provides a high-performance, lightweight, and scalable communication infrastructure for modern distributed systems. The NATS connector enables seamless integration with NATS, making it easy to build reactive and event-driven applications. It supports various messaging patterns, including publish-subscribe, request-reply, and load-balanced queues, and provides advanced features such as JetStream for persistent messaging.

typeDefs.name: StreamConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Determines the properties for a stream.

fields.name: name
fields.description: A name for the stream

fields.name: description
fields.description: A short description of the purpose of this stream

fields.name: subjects
fields.description:
Which NATS subject/subjects to populate this stream with. Supports wildcards. Defaults to just the
configured stream name

fields.name: retentionPolicy
fields.description: How message retention is considered, Limits (default), Interest or WorkQueue

fields.name: maxConsumers
fields.description: How many consumers can be defined for the stream, -1 for unlimited

fields.name: maxMsgs
fields.description: How large the stream may become in total messages before the configured discard policy takes action

fields.name: maxMsgsPerSubject
fields.description: Maximum amount of messages to retain per subject

fields.name: maxBytes
fields.description: How large the stream may become in total bytes before the configured discard policy takes action

fields.name: maxAge
fields.description: Maximum age of any message in the stream, expressed in seconds

fields.name: maxMsgSize
fields.description: The largest message that will be accepted by the Stream

fields.name: storageType
fields.description: The type of storage backend, File and Memory

fields.name: replicas
fields.description: The number of replicas to store this message on

fields.name: noAck
fields.description: If set, then acknowledgements are not sent back to the client

fields.name: discardPolicy
fields.description: When a stream has reached its configured maxBytes or maxMsgs, this policy takes action

typeDefs.name: RetentionPolicy

typeDefs.name: StorageType
typeDefs.description: The type of storage backend, File and Memory

typeDefs.name: DiscardPolicy
typeDefs.description:
When a Stream has reached its configured maxMsgs or maxBytes, this policy kicks in. 
New refuses new messages or Old (default) deletes old messages to make space

typeDefs.name: RetryConfig
typeDefs.description: Configurations related to connection reconnect attempts.

fields.name: maxReconnect
fields.description:
Maximum number of reconnect attempts. The reconnect state is triggered when an already established
connection is lost. During the initial connection attempt, the client will cycle
over its server list one time regardless of the `maxReconnects` value that is set.
Use 0 to turn off auto reconnecting.
Use -1 to turn on infinite reconnects.

fields.name: reconnectWait
fields.description: The time(in seconds) to wait between the reconnect attempts to reconnect to the same server

fields.name: connectionTimeout
fields.description: The timeout (in seconds) for the connection attempts

fields.description: The interval (in seconds) between the attempts of pinging the server

fields.name: maxPingsOut
fields.description: The maximum number of pings the client can have in flight

Parameters to set limits on the maximum number of pending messages

typeDefs.name: PendingLimits
typeDefs.description:
The configurations to set limits on the maximum number of messages or maximum size of messages this consumer will
hold before it starts to drop new messages waiting for the resource functions to drain the queue.
Setting a value less than or equal to 0 will disable this check.

fields.name: maxMessages
fields.description:
Maximum number of pending messages retrieved and held by the consumer service.
The default value is 65536

fields.name: maxBytes
fields.description:
Total size of pending messages in bytes retrieved and held by the consumer service.
The default value is 67108864

clients.name: JetStreamCaller
clients.description: The client that provides functionality related to acknowledging a JetStream message.

functions.name: init
functions.description: The client that provides functionality related to acknowledging a JetStream message.

functions.name: ack
functions.description:
Acknowledges a JetStream messages received from a Consumer, indicating
the message should not be received again later.
```ballerina
check jetStreamCaller->ack();
```

functions.name: nak
functions.description:
Acknowledges a JetStream message has been received but indicates 
that the message is not completely processed and should be sent again later.
```ballerina
check jetStreamCaller->nak();
```

functions.name: inProgress
functions.description:
Indicates that this message is being worked on and reset redelivery timer 
in the server.
```ballerina
check jetStreamCaller->inProgress();
```
